description: This Java class 'UtilProperties' provides utility methods for managing application properties, including loading, caching, and retrieving properties from files, URLs, and resource bundles. It supports multiple formats such as standard properties, XML, and custom OFBiz XML formats, with locale-specific handling and resource resolution.

classes.name: UtilResourceBundle
classes.description: Custom extension of ResourceBundle with caching and support for OFBiz XML properties format.

classes.name: ExtendedProperties
classes.description: Extension of Properties class supporting OFBiz custom XML properties format.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Compares a property value to a string for equality.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Compares a property value to a string ignoring case.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property from a resource.

methods.name: createProperties
methods.description: Creates a Properties instance from a filename.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads Properties from a resource or URL.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Loads a ResourceBundle for a resource and locale.

methods.name: getResourceBundleMap
methods.description: Wraps a ResourceBundle in a Map wrapper.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts XML InputStream to Properties, supporting OFBiz XML format.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves a resource URL with locale-specific fallback.

methods.name: isPropertiesResourceNotFound
methods.description: Checks if a resource is marked as not found.

methods.name: getCandidateLocales
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate locales for resource lookup.

methods.name: getDefaultCandidateLocales
methods.description: Returns the default set of candidate locales.
